name: System Startup
purpose: Application start: shows the splash, opens the kontroller and data files, starts the session, selector connector and virtual list modules, makes sure the meta, global and utility tables each have their one record, logs the user in when initial setup is done (closing the file for non-admin accounts if the login fails), then goes to the welcome slide for a new install or opens the user home. On a development server with a Full Access account it also starts the dev, generator, ZeitGeist, konnector, log, tester and build files.
